errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check that it is running, then try again.
errors.unsupportedType: This file isn't a valid PDF or DOCX. Only those two formats are supported.
errors.tooLarge: This file is larger than the {{limit}} limit.
errors.tooLargeGeneric: This file is larger than the upload limit.
errors.invalidFile: The server rejected this file as invalid.
errors.server: The server had a problem handling this request. Try again in a moment.

codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.LLM_UNAVAILABLE: The AI model isn't available: the server has no API key, or the model service can't be reached.
codes.LLM_TIMEOUT: The AI model took too long to respond. Try again.
codes.MESSAGE_TOO_LONG: The question is longer than 2000 characters.
codes.DOCUMENT_NOT_READY: The document is still being processed.
codes.DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE_FOR_COMPARISON: A document is too long to compare (over 3000 sentences).
codes.PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE: No preview is available for this document.
codes.PAGE_NOT_FOUND: This page doesn't exist in the document.
codes.PARSE_FAILED: The file couldn't be read. It may be damaged.
codes.PASSWORD_PROTECTED: The file is password-protected. Remove the password and upload it again.
codes.NO_TEXT_FOUND: No text was found. It looks like a scan, and OCR isn't available on the server.
codes.OCR_FAILED: Text recognition (OCR) failed for this file.
codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server had an internal problem. Start again.
codes.STREAM_INTERRUPTED: The connection dropped before the answer finished. Try again.
codes.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The server took too long to respond. Try again in a moment.
codes.UNAUTHORIZED: The session is no longer valid. Try again.
codes.SESSION_EXPIRED: This session has ended, so its documents are no longer available.
codes.DEMO_READ_ONLY: Demo documents can't be changed or deleted.
codes.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Your limit for this session is reached. Delete something and try again.
codes.AI_SESSION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Your AI questions for today are used up. They renew within a day. Reading documents still works.
codes.AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: AI answers are unavailable for now. They renew within a day. Reading documents still works.
codes.STORAGE_FULL: The server has no room for more documents right now. Try again later.
codes.DOCUMENT_TOO_COMPLEX: This file needs too much time or memory to read.
codes.DOCX_TOO_LARGE: This DOCX is too large once unpacked.

errors.rateLimitedWait: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.sessionReplaced: This session has ended, so its documents are no longer available. You can upload them again.

viewer.failedBody: The server couldn't process this document.

viewer.invalidBody: The file looks corrupted or isn't really a PDF.
viewer.loadBody: Check the server connection and try again.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.demoBody: This is not AI. It searches the PDF's real text by keyword, in your browser. Quotes and page numbers are real.
chat.demoAnswer_one: Found {{count}} passage that matches your question {{markers}}. This is a keyword match, so read the quote to judge whether it answers you.
chat.demoAnswer_other: Found {{count}} passages that match your question {{markers}}. These are keyword matches, so read the quotes to judge whether they answer you.
chat.emptyBody: Results show the exact quote and page, and you can open each one to check it.
chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.failed: The question couldn't be processed. Your conversation is safe, so try again.
chat.notFoundBody: No passage matches your question, so there is nothing to cite. Try other words from the document.

docx.title: Questions need a PDF for now
docx.body: Demo search only reads PDFs. Switch to AI to ask about a DOCX.

no-text.title: This PDF has no readable text
no-text.body: It looks like a scan. Demo search only reads a PDF's text layer.

no-file.title: Nothing to search yet
no-file.body: The document's text isn't available on this device.

pdf-error.title: The document couldn't be read
pdf-error.body: Without its text there is nothing to search.

failed.title: Processing failed
failed.body: The server couldn't process this document.

chat.streaming: Writing. Sources are checked when the answer ends, and unsupported text is removed.
chat.stoppedUnverified: Stopped. This partial text has no checked sources, so don't rely on it.
chat.waitingProcessing: Available when the server finishes processing
chat.suggestDates: What are the key dates and deadlines?
chat.workingLive: Searching the document and waiting for the AI model…
chat.notVerifiedTitle: No answer that could be verified

notFoundReason.no_matching_excerpt: No passage in the document matches your question, so the AI wasn't asked. Try other words.
notFoundReason.model_refused: The AI read the closest passages and found no answer to this in them.
notFoundReason.no_citation: The AI's reply cited no passage of the document, so it was removed. Try asking more specifically.
notFoundReason.citations_failed_verification: The AI's citations didn't match the document's text, so the reply was removed. Try asking more specifically.
notFoundReason.empty_answer: The AI returned an empty reply. Try again or rephrase the question.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageBody: Used for the interface in this browser.
settings.appearanceBody: How the interface looks and moves.
settings.accountBody: Accounts aren't part of this version. There is no sign-in, and everything uploaded is visible to anyone using this server.
settings.localDataBody: PDFs you upload are also saved in this browser, so they can be previewed while the server processes them.
settings.aboutBody: These values come from the running server, not from this app.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address doesn't match anything in DOCMIND.

compare.title: Compare documents
compare.subtitle: Choose two versions of a document. See what was added, removed or modified, side by side, with the original text.
compare.noticeBody: Sentences are matched by similarity. It doesn't understand meaning, detect contradictions, or score anything. A moved sentence shows as removed and added.
compare.noDifferencesBody: The two documents match sentence by sentence.
compare.needTwoBody: Upload another document and wait until it's ready.
compare.deletedBody: It was deleted after this comparison ran, so it can't be shown.
compare.unverified: This quote couldn't be verified in the document, so it isn't shown.
compare.lockHint: Scrolls both documents by the same share of their length. Pages may not line up exactly.
compare.noteUnrelated: No sentence here has a similar counterpart, so these may be unrelated documents. This list is unlikely to be useful as a comparison.
compare.noteDocx: DOCX has no page preview and the comparison gives no section for it, so its changes appear only as text here.
compare.noteOcr: A scanned document was read with OCR, so some differences may be recognition errors.
compare.needTwoWaiting: Wait until your documents finish processing. Only ready documents can be compared.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.previewHint: Click to open in the document

status.coordinates: Exact passage highlighted from the server's coordinates.
status.text: No coordinates from the server. The passage was found in the page's text and highlighted.
status.page: Page opened. The exact passage couldn't be located, so nothing is highlighted.
status.unknown: Locating the passage on the page…
status.section: This source has a section but no known position in the text, so only the quote is shown.
status.viewerError: The document couldn't be displayed. The quote is still shown here.
status.viewerUnavailable: The document preview isn't available, so the page can't be shown. The quote is still here.
status.otherDocument: This source belongs to another document, so it can't be shown here.
status.block: The cited passage is marked in the document's text. DOCX has no stable pages, so none is given.
status.pageOcr: This is the cited page. It was read with OCR, so the exact passage can't be highlighted.

map.canvas: Map of the document's topics. Use the arrow keys to move, plus and minus to zoom.
map.noticeBody: Topics are repeated terms from this PDF. A link means they share sentences, not that they are related in meaning.
map.emptyTitle: Too little text for a map
map.emptyBody: No term repeats in this document, or its pages have no text layer, such as a scan.
map.unavailableDocx: The map reads text in the browser, which works only for PDF for now.
map.unavailableOther: The document's text isn't available on this device.

userModes.title: Mode
userModes.insertHint: Adds the prompt to your message so you can edit it. Nothing is sent yet.
userModes.tooLong: Your message is too long to add this prompt. Your text was kept.
userModes.demoNote: Suggested actions need AI answers. Demo search only matches keywords, so switch to AI to use them.
userModes.waitingNote: Suggested actions appear when the document is ready.
userModes.unavailableNote: Suggested actions aren't available for this document.
userModes.legalNote: Not legal advice. Answers only explain what the document says, for review by a qualified person.
userModes.uploadFirst: Upload a document first. Actions become available next to it once it's ready.
userModes.openDocumentFirst: Open a document to use these actions.

business.name: Business
business.description: Pull out figures, decisions and risks.

summary.label: Summarize key points
summary.prompt: Summarize the main topics and key points of this document in a short list. Cite the supporting passages.

dates.label: Find dates and deadlines
dates.prompt: List the dates, deadlines and time periods stated in this document and what each one refers to. Cite the supporting passages.

requirements.label: Find main requirements
requirements.prompt: List the main requirements, conditions and rules stated in this document. Cite the supporting passages.

explain.label: Explain key concepts
explain.prompt: Explain the most important concepts and terms in this document in clear language. Use examples only when the document supports them. Cite the supporting passages.

summary.label: Summarize for revision
summary.prompt: Summarize the main ideas, topics and conclusions of this document so I can revise them. Cite the supporting passages.

guide.label: Create a study guide
guide.prompt: Create a study guide from this document: main topics, key concepts and definitions, and what to remember for each. Cite the supporting passages.

questions.label: Practice questions
questions.prompt: Create practice questions with answers on the main topics and concepts of this document. Use only facts it states. Cite the supporting passages.

definitions.label: Find definitions
definitions.prompt: Find the important terms and definitions given in this document and quote how each one is defined. Cite the supporting passages.

outline.label: Lesson outline
outline.prompt: Create a lesson outline from this educational material: topics, order, and key concepts for each part. Use only what the material states. Cite the supporting passages.

discussion.label: Discussion questions
discussion.prompt: Create discussion questions on the topics of this educational material. For each question, name the topic. Do not introduce unsupported facts. Cite the supporting passages.

objectives.label: Learning objectives
objectives.prompt: Identify the learning objectives, skills and knowledge that this educational material covers. Cite the supporting passages.

summary.label: Summarize the material
summary.prompt: Summarize the main topics and concepts of this educational material for preparing a class. Cite the supporting passages.

activities.label: Classroom activities
activities.prompt: Suggest classroom activities and exercises based on the topics and tasks in this educational material. Say which activities are your suggestion and which come from the material. Cite the supporting passages.

clauses.label: Key clauses
clauses.prompt: Identify the important clauses of this contract, including term, payment, liability and termination, and explain what each one says. Cite the supporting passages.

obligations.label: Obligations and deadlines
obligations.prompt: List the obligations of each party and the deadlines and time periods for them, as stated in this contract. Cite the supporting passages.

terms.label: Compare terms by party
terms.prompt: Compare the rights, obligations and conditions this contract sets for each party, side by side. Cite the supporting passages.

risks.label: Flag risks for review
risks.prompt: Identify clauses that may need legal review, including penalties, liability, termination and ambiguous wording. Explain the text only. Do not give legal conclusions. Cite the supporting passages.

definitions.label: Definitions and duties
definitions.prompt: Extract the defined terms and the responsibilities of each party from this contract, as written. Cite the supporting passages.

insights.label: Key insights
insights.prompt: Identify the main business findings of this document: results, decisions and risks. Clearly separate documented facts from interpretation. Cite the supporting passages.

figures.label: Financial figures
figures.prompt: Extract the financial figures in this document, such as revenue, costs, fees, budgets and percentages, and what each one refers to. Cite the supporting passages.

summary.label: Summarize the report
summary.prompt: Summarize this report for a manager: main results, figures, conclusions and recommendations. Cite the supporting passages.

terms.label: Compare options and terms
terms.prompt: Compare the options, offers, prices or conditions this document describes, side by side. Use only what it states. Cite the supporting passages.

actions.label: Risks and action items
actions.prompt: List the risks, decisions, action items and responsible parties stated in this document. Cite the supporting passages.

facts.title: Facts
facts.note: Found by text patterns, not by AI. Every item shows the sentence it came from.
facts.emptyBody: No dates, deadlines, amounts or percentages were recognized in this document.
facts.notReady: Facts appear when the server finishes processing.
facts.failed: This document couldn't be processed, so it has no facts.
facts.noJump: The sentence couldn't be located in the text, so there is nothing to open.
facts.suggestedHint: Fills in the question for you to edit. Nothing is sent until you send it.

docx.label: Text of the document
docx.note: Extracted text: the original layout isn't shown, and Word has no stable pages.
docx.emptyTitle: This document has no text to show
